about: Package 1 (shared controls): every scenario this package makes runnable, each with what it exercises. 31-controls.mjs holds on the concept page too (--page hotstep-tiers.html: all pass there but its S-18 one, which is pending as the concept gets it wrong); 32-controls-gallery.mjs drives the parts no module the page draws yet can show (they stand in containers packages 2 and 3 build), in the test build's parts gallery, and runs on the rebuild only. `excluded` lists the concept's scenarios that exercise these controls and still cannot run, each with what it waits for.

scenarios.why: numberBox: typing, Enter, the arrows, Page, Shift, a word refused and said, out of range clamped and said, Escape, scrubbing, the seconds under it (21-numbox.js).
ruler: the estimate on auto, the auto button, a press and a drag, the value contract's keys, the cap at the end, a double-click back to auto.
ruler: 'up to 4:00' where the model ends the song and auto off starting there (S-17), an exact length without an estimate.
ruler markers: Beat I/O at both ends, the line when it is longer than the song, the trim tag.

pick, plugin variant, and its dropdown: the periodic table, its header, typing into the filter, Enter takes the first match, ArrowDown opens, Escape, the grid of curves, no match said, Home, End, Tab carries on, a click chooses.
choiceRow's marker: a value between its choices checks none, marks its place and says it, the Tab stop is the nearest, an arrow goes on from the value (Q-08).
token: the arrows, a sideways drag, Enter to type, Escape, a double-click reset.
pill; choiceRow's mood look with its radio keys.
textField: a check marks while typing, a keeping field keeps and says nothing is applied, a valid list set on Enter, a field that does not keep refuses, puts back and says what it kept.
chips on a side unit: its caps label, its short words, a press chooses and marks it changed.
Pending (S-18) in the concept, right here: Delete and Backspace reset a ruler and a token.
fader: a slider with its value and unity line, the keys, a press and a drag, a double-click and Delete reset.
lcdNumber: typing, an arrow, clamped and said, scrubbing.
lcdButton, flag, recButton, lockButton: each switches on and off, says it is pressed, is marked, is one named step.
powerChip: on while its number is not the off value, a press sets the off value and the chip says so.
termChips, lcdChips, chips: a press chooses.
lookback: the lit bars, Left reaches further back, Right less, End, a hand along it.
pick's chip, model and stamp variants and their lists: open on the chosen one, the arrows and Enter, Escape, the stamps' filter and the language used last first, Tab carries on.
pick's LCD variant: the arrows beside it cycle and wrap, its LCD list, Home and Enter.
numberBox: passing through it with Tab stores and marks nothing (B-27).
numberBox: an arrow in the box, then Undo after leaving it leaves focus out of it (L-05).
pick, plugin variant: a short list is cards with their names (S-02).
Pending (S-18) in the concept, right here: Delete on a focused knob resets it (the value contract, kit/value.ts, which this package extended).
Pending (S-31) in the concept, right here: dragging a length ruler snaps to round values.

excluded.why: Its BPM box is Tempo's lcdNumber inside an LCD row (lcdRow, package 2). Its number-box checks are in 31-controls/number-box-types-steps-and-scrubs; the lcdNumber's in 32-controls-gallery/lcd-number-types-and-steps.

Its LCD picker and the knobs a schedule brings are in rack groups (group, package 2), its time signature in an LCD row (package 2), its model picker in the engine panel (package 5); and it finds options by data-opt as their label (deviation 10). Its plugin checks are in 31-controls/plugin-picker-table-grid-and-filter.

The stamp is on the lyric sheet (package 4), and it reads the concept's storage key hs3-lang-recent (deviation 5: the page keeps hotstep.create.langRecent). The stamp's list is in 32-controls-gallery/chip-model-and-stamp-pickers.
The planner seed is a terminal field (terminal, package 2); Insert example and the scope are package 3's. Its kept-field checks are in 31-controls/checked-text-keeps-or-refuses.
Its LED switch and segments are in the planner's terminal (package 2), its AUTO in Tempo's LCD row (package 2), and it inserts the concept's ctlHTML markup, which the rebuild has no counterpart for.
Its look-back strip is in the repetition guard's terminal (package 2) and its CFG handles the Sampler scope's (package 3).
Pending (S-28): the token's scrub moves with the value (src/derive/controls.ts scrubValue); the token it drags is in the planner's terminal (package 2), which then makes it runnable.

Pending (S-06): the ruler's markers read the tempo the song will have (src/derive/controls.ts songTempo, S-07); the scenario presses the BPM chips (capChips, package 3) and types in the prompt (package 4).
